### Core Capabilities

**Autonomous Detection**  
Our AI watches every camera simultaneously — 24/7, without fatigue. Detect people, vehicles, objects, and behaviors the instant they appear in frame. Real-time multi-camera monitoring. Automated threat classification. Works with existing cameras.

**Autonomous Behavior Analysis**  
Context-aware AI detects loitering, crowd anomalies, restricted zone breaches, and abnormal patterns before they become incidents. Crowd density & flow mapping. Abnormal behavior detection. Restricted zone enforcement.

---

### MJ Device X
MJ Device X is a plug-and-play AI edge processor that connects to any existing camera — CCTV, IP, analog, or PTZ — and instantly upgrades it to a full AI-powered surveillance node.

**How it works:**
1. Connect to any camera via USB-C, PoE, or HDMI — setup under 90 seconds
2. 12 TOPS on-device neural processor runs MJ Vision AI models at <18ms per frame, no cloud latency
3. AES-256 encrypted sync — only intelligence transmitted, footage stays on-site
4. Real-time alerts to security dashboard, Slack, Teams, or PagerDuty within 300ms

**Specs:** 12 TOPS Edge NPU · <18ms inference · 4K 30fps · PoE + USB-C · 14 on-device models · 64GB eMMC · 8W max · −20°C to 65°C · CE · FCC · RoHS · ISO 27001 · NDAA

**Compatible:** Analog CCTV · IP/Network (ONVIF) · PTZ · Thermal/IR · Enterprise VMS (Milestone, Genetec, Avigilon, Hikvision)

## Page: Technology
**URL:** https://mjinnovations.net/technology.html

### Platform Overview
Deep learning models built exclusively for surveillance — trained on 2B+ real-world frames, optimised for lowest false-positive rates and fastest detection latency.

**Key Specs:** 97.3% detection accuracy · <12ms frame latency · <300ms alert dispatch · 14+ AI models · 2B+ training frames

### End-to-End Pipeline (pixel to protected, <300ms total)
1. Capture — camera frame via RTSP/ONVIF (0ms)
2. Decode — GPU-accelerated frame decode (1–3ms)
3. AI Analyse — Vision + Behaviour models in parallel (4–12ms)
4. Detect — threat identified, confidence scored (<12ms)
5. Verify — threshold check, false-positive filter (<50ms)
6. Alert — team notified with video evidence (<300ms)

---

### Engine 01 — MJ Vision AI (MJ-Vision-X1)
Real-time multi-class detection across all camera feeds simultaneously. Custom transformer + CNN hybrid architecture trained on 2B+ surveillance frames across 40+ environment types.

**Detects:** People · Vehicles · Objects · Behaviours  
**Specs:** 97.3% accuracy · <12ms/frame · 60fps max · Unlimited cameras · Night vision & thermal support · Cross-camera tracking

---

### Engine 02 — MJ Behaviour AI (MJ-Behav-G2)
Graph neural network modelling spatial and temporal relationships between entities to understand intent. Analyses 30-second context window per entity.

**Detects:** 28 behaviour types including loitering, crowd anomalies, aggression, falls, PPE violations, restricted zone breaches  
**Specs:** 94.8% accuracy · <0.3% false positives · 30-second context · Graph neural network architecture

---

### Engine 03 — MJ Alert Engine (MJ-Alert-A1)
Ultra-low-latency alert orchestration. Routes threats with auto-attached video evidence to the right team across 12+ channels in <300ms.

**Channels:** Slack · MS Teams · SMS/WhatsApp · Email · PagerDuty · Webhooks · REST API  
**Specs:** <300ms dispatch · 12+ channels · Unlimited routing rules · ±30s evidence clip auto-attached · Severity-based escalation · On-call schedule integration

---

### Engine 04 — MJ Forensic Search (MJ-Search-S3)
Semantic search across 365 days of footage using natural language. Describe what you're looking for — returns exact matches across all cameras in <1 second.

**Example:** "Red jacket, male, near exit, after 10pm" → results in 0.8s across 847,000 frames  
**Specs:** <1s per 1M frames · 365-day retention · AES-256 encrypted · 42 languages · Tamper-proof export

---

### Engine 05 — MJ Device X
Edge AI processor for fully offline, on-site inference. Full MJ AI stack runs locally without internet.

**Specs:** 12 TOPS Edge NPU · <18ms/frame · 8 HD streams · 4K 30fps · PoE + USB-C + HDMI · 64GB eMMC · 8W · IP67 · −20°C to 65°C · OTA updates · Fanless  
**Certifications:** CE · FCC · RoHS · ISO 27001 · NDAA
